native_warn.title: Native Bluetooth — adapter conflict check
native_warn.description:
Native mode runs a BLE GATT peripheral on the Pi's Bluetooth adapter via BlueZ/D-Bus. It needs exclusive use of the adapter — Home Assistant's Bluetooth integration (active scanning, ESPHome BLE-proxy, etc.) cannot run on the same adapter at the same time.

The following Bluetooth integrations are currently active and will likely conflict:

{conflicts}

Check the box to disable them now. They stay configured (just disabled) and you can re-enable them any time from Settings → Devices & Services.
